name: Canonical black cover
description: White-on-black full-wrap paperback cover. Geometry is fixed and book-independent: the only per-book inputs are the front emblem (book.json cover_image) and the interior page count / trim / paper (book.json). The Svatantrya mantra-ring sits small and centred on the back cover of EVERY book in this house style — never text, never a second element. Generated by prints/bookkit/cover.py from KDP's published cover formula.

back.note: Blank black back, Svatantrya logo centred only. KDP prints its own barcode bottom-right.

render: chrome --headless --print-to-pdf=cover.pdf http://127.0.0.1:8000/<book>/cover.html (cover.html is written by prints/bookkit/cover.py)
